title: Annotatio III §.VII (2b): Remaining controversies — not for pulpits, or only with utmost modesty; schools and academies likewise without persecution or personal naming (Autor p. 330)
pass_a_gloss: and lest one party thereafter, because of some dissent, should either tear the other with insults or condemn it, it judged advisable and agreed that Controversies still remaining were either not to be treated in the Churches from the pulpit, or certainly with the utmost modesty if Necessity plainly required it — with no mention of Dissenters, no harshness of words, no forged Consequences, only a declaration of truth from Scripture; but in Schools and Academies likewise with great moderation, without persecution, without Personals or name-pointing, whatever remained of the controverted Heads should be treated. Author p. 330.
pass_b_english: and lest either side next tear or damn the other for some leftover dissent, they judged it wise and agreed:

remaining controversies should not be handled from church pulpits — or if necessity plainly forced it, only with utmost modesty, naming no dissenters, using no harsh words, forging no consequences, declaring truth from Scripture alone;
and in schools and academies likewise with great moderation, without persecution, personal attacks, or name-pointing (Autor p. 330).
source_text: & ne pars altera deinceps propter dissensum aliqualem, alteram, vel convitiis proscinderet, vel damnaret, consultum putaverit conveneritque, Controversias, quae adhuc superessent, aut non tractandas fore in Ecclesiis pro Concione, aut certè summâ cum modestia, si Necessitas planè exigeret, Dissentientium nulla mentione, nulla Verborum asperitate, nullis Consequentis affictis, sola veritatis ex Scriptura declaratione; In Scholis verò & Academiis magna pariter cum moderatione citra insectationem, citra Personalia, aut nominum indicia, quicquid reliqvum esset controversorum Capitum, tractaretur. Autor p. 330.
notes: Cassellanum mark (2) close: pulpit discipline + school moderation; Autor p. 330.
